attributes.board_name: Maryland State Board of Veterinary Medical Examiners

rules.accepted_credit_types: AVMA-approved veterinary or veterinary technology college programs; AVMA meetings and courses; local, state, regional or national CE courses; online courses
rules.carryover: Hours earned in the prior 36-month period (within 72 months) may count as unused credit hours.
rules.alternatives: Conditional renewal for exigent circumstances or with a completion plan.
rules.audit_note: Keep attendance records; Board may request verification.
rules.notes: Registration renewed every 3 years by June 30 with proof of compliance.
